# orbivisor_network (Resource)

A network: a Linux bridge/VLAN/VXLAN network or an SDN (OVN) network with subnets.

Manifest kind `Network`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A VLAN on a host bridge
resource "orbivisor_network" "lan" {
  name   = "lan"
  bridge = "vmbr0"
  vlan   = 42
}

# An SDN (OVN) overlay network with a subnet
resource "orbivisor_network" "app" {
  name    = "app"
  folder  = "/prod"
  sdn     = {}
  subnets = [{ cidr = "10.20.0.0/24", gateway = "10.20.0.1" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `bridge` (String) Host bridge (simple networks).
- `folder` (String) Folder path (`/prod/web`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the object (move it with `orbivisorctl folder move` and change the path here instead).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `mtu` (Number) MTU.
- `sdn` (Dynamic) SDN (OVN) settings: subnets, DHCP, QoS, physnet…
- `subnets` (Dynamic) Subnets (IPAM) as a list of objects, e.g. `[{ cidr = "10.0.0.0/24", gateway = "10.0.0.1" }]`.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN id on the bridge.
- `vxlan` (Dynamic) VXLAN overlay settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
